items.name: account-menu
items.title: AccountMenu
items.description: Sidebar header for PaaS surfaces. Avatar + name + (optional) PlanBadge + (optional) secondary line, with dual mode: with onClick renders as a `button` with trailing chevron (account picker affordance); without, renders as a static `div`. PaaS-shape sibling of ProjectSwitcher.

items.name: action-bar
items.title: ActionBar
items.description: Page-top action strip primitive. Three optional slots: search input (flex-1, grows to fill), filter icon button, and primary action button (right-aligned). Returns null when no slots are provided. Used standalone or composed inside <PageShell>. Primary action supports loading state with spinner.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: Persistent inline notice primitive. Four intents (info / success / warning / destructive) with mapped lucide icons (Info / CheckCircle2 / TriangleAlert / AlertCircle) and design tokens. Optional title, description, action slot, and onDismiss handler. destructive intent renders role=alert (assertive); other intents render role=status (polite). Distinct from Toast (transient, auto-dismiss) and EmptyState (centered card).

items.name: attributes-table
items.title: AttributesTable
items.description: Namespace-grouped OTel span attributes with fail-closed PII masking. A masked value's raw string never enters the DOM until Reveal is clicked AND canReveal is true; object values fall back to the dependency-free JsonViewer. Promoted-key badges + collapsible per-namespace cards.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: User/team avatar with safe fallback to initials.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Small status / tag indicator with semantic variants (default, primary, success, warning, destructive, info).

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: Hierarchical navigation trail primitive. Composable nav>ol>li anatomy (List/Item/Link/Page/Separator/Ellipsis) with aria-current on the current page, presentation-role separators, asChild router links and safe-href guarding.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Primitive action element in the Violet Forge design system.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: Surface container for grouping related content.

items.name: chart
items.title: Chart core (computeHistogram)
items.description: Pure chart-data helpers. computeHistogram distributes numeric values into equal-width bins (count per bin; non-finite values dropped; degenerate range collapses to a single bin; upper edge inclusive on the last bin). Zero dependency, total, deterministic.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: Built on Radix Checkbox — accessible binary control with focus ring and indeterminate state support.

items.name: cn
items.title: cn (Tailwind class merger)
items.description: Merge Tailwind classes with conflict resolution.

items.name: code-block
items.title: CodeBlock
items.description: Terminal / code-snippet surface. Renders code inside a <pre> with optional 'terminal' prefix per line ('$ '), optional caption (file name), and optional inline CopyButton in top-right. Copy uses the raw code (without the visual prefix). language prop is forward-compat for future syntax highlighting.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: Single-select typeahead over the cmdk engine with an inline listbox: sync/async filtering (shouldFilter=false), empty and loading states, full keyboard nav, APG combobox ARIA contract.

items.name: command-palette
items.title: CommandPalette
items.description: Cmd+K-style global launcher with arrow-key navigation, fuzzy ranking, and Enter/Escape behavior — built on cmdk + Theo Dialog.

items.name: confirm-dialog
items.title: ConfirmDialog
items.description: Controlled confirmation modal built on Dialog. Auto-focuses Cancel on open (deliberate — NOT the destructive button). Optional intent=destructive switches the confirm button to destructive variant. Optional confirmationPhrase enables typed-confirmation guard (case-sensitive, empty string = no phrase). Async onConfirm shows Loader2 spinner; resolve closes the dialog; reject keeps it open so consumers can surface their own error. Enter in the phrase input triggers confirm when matched.

items.name: copy-button
items.title: CopyButton
items.description: Click-to-copy button primitive. Wraps navigator.clipboard.writeText with icon swap (Copy → Check on success, Copy → X on failure), aria-live announcement for screen readers, optional label, ghost/outline variants, and SSR-safe rendering. Auto-cleans the revert timer on unmount and debounces double-clicks.

items.name: danger-zone
items.title: DangerZone
items.description: Destructive-actions section primitive with sub-component DangerZone.Action. Red-bordered container with title bar (default 'Danger Zone') and action rows. Each row carries title + description + consumer-provided action slot (typically a destructive Button). Rows separated by hairline dividers; last row drops the bottom border via last:border-b-0.

items.name: data-table
items.title: DataTable
items.description: Generic, sortable, expandable composite over <Table>. Operator-grade entity-list patterns: sortable headers (controlled OR uncontrolled), sticky header, expandable rows (multi default + expandMode='single' opt-in), row action menus via DropdownMenu, client-side pagination, loading skeleton, empty state. Generic over T (e.g. DataTable<Domain>). Virtualized mode (10K+ rows over @tanstack/react-virtual): fixed row heights, sticky header, mutually exclusive with pagination/expandable at the type level.

items.name: deployment-row
items.title: DeploymentRow
items.description: One row in a deployment list (table-ish layout).

items.name: description-list
items.title: DescriptionList
items.description: Semantic key/value pairs on native dl/dt/dd: vertical or horizontal (grid) layouts, dense mode, composable Item/Term/Detail subs.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: Modal overlay built on Radix Dialog.

items.name: domain-config
items.title: DomainConfig
items.description: Manage custom domains for a project.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: DropdownMenu
items.description: Accessible dropdown menu primitive built on @radix-ui/react-dropdown-menu. Sub-components attached via Object.assign (Trigger, Content, Item, CheckboxItem, RadioItem, Label, Separator, Shortcut, Group, Sub, SubTrigger, SubContent, RadioGroup). Styled with @theokit/ui design tokens. Consolidates the 5 prior direct-Radix usages under a single wrapper.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: EmptyState
items.description: Visual placeholder for empty lists / first-run screens.

items.name: env-var-editor
items.title: EnvVarEditor
items.description: Table-like editor for environment variables.

items.name: env
items.title: Environment helpers
items.description: Typed environment helpers (isDev / isProd) reading NODE_ENV through a single accessor that works in browser bundlers, Node/SSR, and unbundled browsers.

items.name: file-dropzone
items.title: FileDropzone
items.description: Drag-drop + file-picker upload primitive, dependency-free (native HTML5 DnD): typed rejections (invalid type / too large / too small / too many), accept map with MIME wildcard and extension matching, nested-drag target counting, keyboard-accessible picker, idle/drag-over/drag-reject/disabled states.

items.name: form-field
items.title: FormField
items.description: Composition wrapper for accessible form rows.

items.name: histogram
items.title: Histogram
items.description: Distribution of numeric values as pure-SVG bars (no chart lib). Accepts pre-computed bins OR raw values + binCount (binned client-side via computeHistogram). Bar height scaled via niceMax; honest empty state; sr-only table for a11y parity. Reuses linScale/niceMax from TrendChart.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: Text input primitive with focus ring, error state, and form-field composition support.

items.name: io-cards
items.title: IOCards
items.description: Span input/output rendering: a ChatML message array becomes role-labeled cards with tool-call/result linkage and long-history collapse; markdown bodies go through an optional renderMarkdown slot (default plain text, XSS-safe by construction — no dangerouslySetInnerHTML); non-chat payloads fall back to JsonViewer.

items.name: json-viewer
items.title: JsonViewer
items.description: Read-only collapsible JSON tree, dependency-free: boolean/depth collapse with lazy subtrees, per-type rendering (BigInt, Date, undefined), long-string truncation, circular-safe rendering and copy via CopyButton.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: Form field label built on Radix Label.

items.name: live-region-context
items.title: LiveRegionContext
items.description: React context that coordinates aria-live declarations across nested components to prevent screen-reader double-announcement (T4.1).

items.name: login-split
items.title: LoginSplit
items.description: 50/50 split shell for authentication screens — form pane on the left, illustration on the right.

items.name: metric-card
items.title: MetricCard
items.description: Dashboard metric tile composite — title + value + delta with trend semantics. Supports invertTrend for cost/churn metrics (EC-17).

items.name: metrics-panel
items.title: MetricsPanel
items.description: Grid of metric tiles for observability dashboards.

items.name: page-shell
items.title: PageShell
items.description: Page-level scaffold composite. Renders title + optional description + optional ActionBar (when search/primaryAction/onFilterClick provided), then one of four mutually-exclusive content states (loading > error > empty > children). Loading defaults to a centered spinner Card; loadingNode escape hatch lets consumers pass custom skeleton. Error state renders Card with message + optional retry button + optional docsHref. Empty state delegates to <EmptyState>. PageShell does NOT manage document.title — pass onTitleChange callback to wire your own hook.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Accessible page-number navigation primitive. Renders <nav aria-label=Pagination> with first/prev/numbers/next/last buttons and visual ellipses when totalPages exceeds the visible range. Active page carries aria-current=page. Keyboard nav: ArrowLeft / ArrowRight / Home / End. Configurable siblingCount + optional jump buttons. Returns null when totalPages <= 1. Exports a pure computePageRange helper for unit testing the range logic in isolation.

items.name: percentile-chart
items.title: PercentileChart
items.description: p50/p95/p99 over time as shaded bands (not three flat lines) in pure SVG. The p50–p95 and p95–p99 spans render as filled areas + a p50 reference line, so the spread reads at a glance. Honest empty state; sr-only table for a11y parity. Reuses linScale/niceMax/seriesPath from TrendChart.

items.name: pin-input
items.title: PinInput
items.description: Multi-slot OTP / code input primitive. N separate boxes (default 6) that auto-advance focus on input. Paste fills all slots from clipboard with whitespace stripped. Arrow keys navigate; backspace clears current slot then moves focus back when empty. numeric / alphanumeric inputMode (default numeric, triggers mobile numeric keyboard via pattern=[0-9]*). Optional mask renders bullets. Optional error state applies destructive border. onComplete fires once when value reaches length — NOT on mount with pre-filled value.

items.name: plan-badge
items.title: PlanBadge
items.description: Semantic pricing-tier badge. Five canonical tiers (free, hobby, pro, team, enterprise) with distinct color tokens. Consumers self-document intent (plan="hobby") instead of mapping generic Badge variants per app — future rebrand / dark-mode tweaks propagate automatically.

items.name: preview-env-card
items.title: PreviewEnvCard
items.description: Preview environment card surfacing all services from one PR.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: Accessible progress bar primitive with intent variants (default, success, warning, destructive), 4 heights (h-1 / h-1.5 / h-2 / h-3), and an indeterminate animated state. Built on role="progressbar" + ARIA semantics.

items.name: project-card
items.title: ProjectCard
items.description: Surface for a project in a project listing.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: RadioGroup
items.description: Built on Radix RadioGroup — accessible radio group with roving focus and orientation control.

items.name: rollback-ui
items.title: RollbackUI
items.description: Instant rollback selector showing recent versions.

items.name: safe-href
items.title: safeHref (XSS-safe URL guard)
items.description: Defang javascript:/vbscript:/data:text/html URIs before rendering as <a href>. Returns undefined for dangerous protocols so the caller can render a non-link fallback.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: ScrollArea
items.description: Custom scroller with Violet Forge styling.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Styled wrapper around Radix Select.

items.name: session-summary
items.title: SessionSummary
items.description: A dl of honest aggregate metrics over a session's traces: trace count, wall-clock window, ∑cost, ∑tokens, error count (destructive when >0), distinct models. Sums of zero are honest, never an em-dash.

items.name: session-timeline
items.title: SessionTimeline
items.description: Temporal replay of a session: one row per trace sorted by start time, each with timestamp, name, a duration bar relative to the session window (reuses the trace-core bar layout), status, and cost. Controlled selection; virtualizes above a threshold.

items.name: session
items.title: Session core (SessionTraceItem + aggregateSession)
items.description: Trace-level session data contract + honest metric aggregation (traceCount, wall-clock window, ∑cost, ∑tokens, error count, distinct models). Pure, total — absent cost/tokens count as 0, never NaN. Reuses the trace-core timestamp normalization.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: Slide-in side panel built on Radix Dialog.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: Vertical navigation shell with header, sections, items (active / count), and footer slots.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Placeholder block shown while content is loading.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: Range input primitive over Radix Slider: single or multi-thumb, decimal steps, clickable labelled marks, value clamped to [min,max], accessible thumb labels.

items.name: social-auth-row
items.title: SocialAuthRow
items.description: Row of OAuth provider buttons.

items.name: span-graph
items.title: SpanGraph
items.description: Dependency-free SVG rendering of a trace as a layered agent graph (depth = distance from root, order = index within depth). Edges follow parent/call order; the root→selected path is highlighted; over a node cap it renders an honest 'too large' state. No chart/layout library (SVG-pure). Focusable nodes, controlled selection.

items.name: span-tree
items.title: SpanTree
items.description: Accessible, controllable tree of trace spans with full WAI-ARIA APG TreeView semantics (treeitem/level/posinset/setsize/selected/expanded/group), keyboard navigation (↑/↓/Home/End/Enter), a dual recursive/virtualized render path, an optional inline timeline bar, and per-kind badges. Fully controlled selection + collapse.

items.name: span-waterfall
items.title: SpanWaterfall
items.description: Trace waterfall: a nice-interval (1/2/5×10ⁿ) time axis over percentage-positioned, row-packed span bars, a hover-needle reading the absolute wall-clock time under the pointer, a ∑ rollup-cost badge on parent rows, and dashed 'unbounded' bars for in-flight / clock-skewed spans. Controlled selection.

items.name: stat-tile
items.title: StatTile
items.description: Big-number stat tile primitive for dashboard summaries. Renders value + label + optional icon + optional delta (trend up/down/flat with TrendingUp/TrendingDown/Minus icons and success/destructive/muted color). Dual mode: with onClick renders as button with hover state + trailing ArrowUpRight chevron; without, renders as static div. Value uses font-display tabular-nums whitespace-nowrap.

items.name: status-dot
items.title: StatusDot
items.description: Semantic status indicator (small colored circle + optional label). Five status kinds: live (success), building (warning, auto-pulses), failed (destructive), idle (muted), warning (warning, static). Three sizes (xs 6px / sm 8px default / md 10px). When neither label nor aria-label is provided, auto-applies aria-label=status and emits a dev warning.

items.name: status-indicator
items.title: StatusIndicator
items.description: Operational state indicator (online/offline/degraded/info) consuming status-* semantic tokens (ADR-0007).

items.name: stepper
items.title: Stepper
items.description: Multi-step pipeline progress list promoted from a production build timeline: explicit per-step status (pending/active/done/failed), vertical/horizontal orientations, optional timestamp and failed-only retry slots, ol+aria-current accessibility.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: Built on Radix Switch — accessible binary toggle with on / off states and disabled support.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Semantic data-table primitive with sub-components (Table.Header, Table.Body, Table.Row, Table.Cell, Table.HeaderCell). Supports density (default | compact via Context), per-cell align (left | center | right), numeric cells (font-mono tabular-nums), and sortable header cells (onSort + sortDirection with ChevronUp/ChevronDown affordance + aria-sort).

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Built on Radix Tabs with active-underline styling and focus-visible ring.

items.name: tailwind-preset
items.title: Theo UI Tailwind preset
items.description: Type scale, fontFamily, colors and motion tokens consumed by every Theo UI component. Add to tailwind.config.ts#presets before installing any other component.

items.name: task-header
items.title: TaskHeader
items.description: Title bar for a task pane — composite combining heading, status badge, and chevron menu.

items.name: task-types
items.title: Theo UI task types
items.description: Shared TypeScript types for task plans, steps, and progress state.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: Multi-line input mirror of Input.

items.name: timestamp
items.title: Timestamp
items.description: Accessible <time> primitive with relative/absolute/both formats, auto-refresh interval (default 60s, 0 disables), native title tooltip with absolute time, and aria-label that always carries the full date. Built on Intl.RelativeTimeFormat (zero deps). value accepts ISO string, Date, or Unix ms (NOT seconds). Invalid date renders empty element; invalid locale falls back to default with dev warning.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Transient notification built on Radix Toast.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Built on Radix Tooltip — accessible hover / focus tooltip with delay and side / align controls.

items.name: topnav
items.title: TopNav
items.description: Horizontal app bar (64px) with breadcrumbs, mode switcher (radiogroup), and action slots.

items.name: trace-compare
items.title: TraceCompare
items.description: Two traces side by side (B vs A baseline): a per-lane metrics header + a structural diff table with honest deltas — a span present in only one trace is marked 'only in A/B' with no fabricated delta. Receives data (lanes); fetching/URL live in the consumer.

items.name: trace-transcript
items.title: TraceTranscript
items.description: Reader-mode feed of a trace: one card per span (role badge + output preview + token/cost/duration micro-stats), with collapsible group headers for subagent subtrees (nesting-safe: descendants come from the tree). Virtualizes above a threshold. Controlled selection.

items.name: trace
items.title: Trace core (TraceSpan + pure helpers)
items.description: Shared data contracts and pure, total helpers for the trace-native observability components: the TraceSpan type (phoenix/langfuse/OTel-GenAI intersection), timestamp/duration math, bar-layout geometry, tree flatten + transcript row model, ChatML parsing, cost aggregation, layered graph layout, attribute grouping, and structural trace alignment. No React, no I/O.

items.name: trend-chart
items.title: TrendChart
items.description: Multi-series time-trend chart in pure SVG (zero chart-lib deps): value formatter, color legend, sparse-series markers, explicit empty state and a screen-reader data table keyed by shared period axis.

items.name: types
items.title: Theo UI shared types
items.description: Shared TypeScript helper types (IconComponent, etc.) used across Theo UI.
